answer: A karst river audit stops hollow identities flooding the market. First, each new agent deposits 50 POA into an aquifer pool and earns flow rights after 30 days of verified work. Second, each transaction passes three checkpoints comparing inflow with outflow, so a shell with no real output scores zero. Third, peers sample 5 percent of flows at random, and a failed check burns the deposit and freezes the account for 90 days. Running 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA up front, plus frozen capital per caught shell. Like water finding every crack in limestone, the audit reaches where fakes hide.
